content: Vegas Cubanas is a brand of hand-made premium cigars that is owned by El Rey de los Habanos, Inc. The brand was created by José Pepin Garcia and is manufactured at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, which is located in Little Havana, Miami, Florida. It was introduced into national distribution in the year 2005. Vegas Cubanas cigars are Nicaraguan puros, meaning they are made entirely of tobacco grown in Nicaragua. The wrapper is a corojo leaf, which is colorado maduro in color, giving it a rich, dark appearance. These cigars are mild to medium-bodied in strength, offering a balanced smoking experience. They are sold uncellophaned and packaged in boxes containing 25 cigars. Before being shipped, the cigars are aged for a minimum of one year to ensure optimal flavor and quality. This information is documented in Perelman's Pocket Cyclopedia of Cigars, 2006 edition, pages 545-546.
